column1: # box_cell_shapes.tsv -- THE CELL-SHAPE TABLE: the words each box kind carves on the spine at its alpha (ARCH-ZETA-ONE-COORDINATE 3.5 (iii);
# ARCH-THREE-ZETAS-EMISSION 2 (ZALPHA) and 10 (3); the cto, CEO-1923). The planner's carve K_i is this row's alpha_words plus 16 x the spine
# locals first used at the box plus a disjunction's arm extra. util_gen_box_cell_shapes.py writes SCRIP/src/planner/box_cell_shapes.inc from this
# file (--write) and refuses a stale one (--check); the planner's zd_k_own reads the generated rows. Started from zd_k_own (zeta_plan.cpp) as it
# stood at SCRIP c22b86a9b, row for row, so the first landing is byte-identical; a switch moves a kind's state into its own carve by editing its row.
# ROWS ARE EVALUATED TOP TO BOTTOM AND THE FIRST MATCH WINS. THE CONDITIONS OF ONE KIND'S ROWS ARE DISJOINT ACROSS REGIMES (the cfo, 2026-10-24, on the
# ceo's 7ed02df91 finding: the Icon switch's IR_BOUND 16 home_frame row sat ahead of D3's IR_BOUND 0 pl_home and stole 23 Prolog core entries, because home_frame
# and home_state were true of a Prolog home-frame graph too): a condition that names a regime (icn_*, pl_*) is true of that regime's graphs ONLY -- BCS_ICN_HOME is
# false for a Prolog resumable callable (08efb562e, 8e3edbe62), BCS_PL_HOME false for an Icon graph -- so no row of one regime can match another regime's node
# whatever the order; a generic condition (home_frame, home_state, has_operands, always) comes AFTER every regime row of the same kind, and row order carries no
# other meaning. A new row for a kind another regime also carves names its regime in its condition or goes below that regime's rows; util_gen_box_cell_shapes.py
# --check regenerates the .inc and a reviewer reads the kind's rows together. Columns:
#   kind          the IR kind (IR_*), or * for any kind

#   alpha_words   the bytes the box carves at its alpha, or arm_spine (the disjunction's computed arm extent, zd_dj_spine), or call_args (16 x (2 + the call's argument count), or fence_spine (planner_fence_k: 16 for a bounded body, 0 for a frame-homed record), or alt_spine (planner_alt_k: 32 plus the largest arm's live cells, 48 when an arm is unbounded)
#   when          always | call_curmov (a call that moves the cursor) | icn_local (an Icon local variable read in a spine-cells graph) |

#                 icn_suspend (an Icon suspend in a spine-cells graph) | icn_home (a home-frame graph that is not Prolog-resumable: Icon, and Raku and Pascal where a row names their kinds) | has_operands | no_operands | patv (a static PATV$ deferred pattern)
#   gamma_release, omega_release, fenced    the gamma law's columns, '-' until pass (iv) reads them from here
#   source        why the box carves what it carves
